specs.name: Switch type and options
specs.value: Mechanical; Red, Blue, Brown. The supplied information does not establish that all RK61 revisions have the same switch options.

specs.name: Actuation force
specs.value: 40 g (RK Red); figures for other switches are not confirmed by the supplied official sources.

specs.name: Key travel
specs.value: RK Red: 2.0 mm actuation point; 4.0 mm total travel. Other switch figures are not confirmed by the supplied official sources.

specs.name: Hot-swap socket type
specs.value: Official store listing says compatible 3-pin or 5-pin switches are supported on the Color-Block Edition. Other RK61 revisions may differ.

specs.name: Keycap material and profile
specs.value: ABS shine-through; Cherry profile is listed by the official RK collection. Profile/material may vary by revision.

specs.name: Backlight type
specs.value: Single-color backlight is listed for the official store product; RGB is reported for a separate listing, so the type depends on the specific SKU.

specs.name: Connectivity
specs.value: Official store listing describes Bluetooth 5.1, 2.4 GHz wireless, and USB-C wired connectivity.

specs.name: Polling rate
specs.value: Not confirmed by the official sources provided. A retailer listing reports 1000 Hz, but it does not establish that this applies to every RK61 revision or connection mode.

specs.name: N-key rollover
specs.value: Not confirmed by the official sources provided. A retailer listing reports full NKRO; applicability to all RK61 revisions is unclear.
